decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display sits at the core of the announced display focus and needed little extra investment, so management keeps it and attributes weak visibility in 2020–2021 to the temporary pandemic slump in retail promotions.
Having publicly launched and defended the pegboard-back display as an extension of the core range, management persists and blames soft demand on temporary disruption in in-store retail.
The standard quarter-pallet display is central to the one-stop offering, so dropping it would contradict the firm's stated direction and earlier decisions.

The dedicated investment in wooden pallet production and its visible launch weigh heavily, so management keeps it despite uncertain results, though rising timber costs make it the most exposed product.

The media-product display serves a shrinking niche, but it is close to the core offer and the firm has already defended it, so management keeps it for now and attributes weakness to market conditions.
